get_default_asset_folder: get the default MHR asset folder path for loading model files
get_mhr_fbx_path: get the path to an MHR fbx file for a given LOD level
get_mhr_model_path: get the path to the MHR model definition file across all LODs
load_pose_dirs_predictor: build a PyTorch pose correctives predictor from blendshapes and activation data
has_pose_corrective_blendshapes: check if loaded data contains pose-dependent corrective blendshapes
